verdict.rationale: Veriff provides extensive official SDK documentation across web, iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, and JS SDKs, with version requirements, migration guides, and customization options, all documented in first-party devdocs. However missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK reliability, explicit server-side/backend language SDKs (e.g., Python, Node.js) beyond the JS session-URL SDK, and any AI-agent-specific tooling or examples.
